statute: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (2024)
title: Exceptions, Limitations, and Non-Retroactivity of Disclosure Obligations
content:
Articles 4 and 5 of the WIPO GRATK Treaty (2024) define the scope, exceptions, and non-retroactive application of the mandatory patent disclosure requirement.

Key Treaty Provisions:
1. Non-Retroactivity (Article 5): Contracting Parties shall not impose the mandatory disclosure obligations of the Treaty on patent applications filed before the date of entry into force of the Treaty with respect to that Contracting Party.
2. Scope of Exceptions (Article 4): Contracting Parties may adopt justified exceptions and limitations to the disclosure obligation in special cases, provided that such exceptions do not unjustifiably prejudice the implementation of the Treaty or mutual benefit sharing.
3. Safeguards for Innovation: Ensures legal certainty for existing patent portfolios while establishing binding transparency for all future patent applications based on genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge.
